description: Expand a seed keyword or product category into semantic topic clusters with monthly search volume, CPC benchmarks, and Keyword Difficulty scores. Use this tool when planning topical authority hubs, evaluating commercial and transactional search intent, or discovering conversational prompts that trigger AI answer engines. Returns structured pillar-and-spoke keyword clusters, buyer funnel classifications, conversational LLM prompt variants, and recommended URL slugs.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for search volume and CPC calibration (default: "us").

language.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code for keyword generation and intent classification (default: "en").

max_clusters.description: Maximum number of semantic topic clusters to generate between 1 and 10 (default: 4).

seed_topic.description: Core seed keyword, product category, or topic to expand into semantic intent clusters (e.g., "generative engine optimization api").

name: keyword_intent_cluster
title: Semantic Keyword Intent & Pillar Clustering
